    *   $x_{E,B}$: Emily focuses on Birds.
    *   $x_{D,M}$: David focuses on Mammals.
    *   $x_{D,B}$: David focuses on Birds.
    *   $x_{L,M}$: Laura focuses on Mammals.
    *   $x_{L,B}$: Laura focuses on Birds.

    4.  $\neg x_{E,M} \lor \neg x_{D,M} \lor \neg x_{L,M}$ (Not all focus on Mammals).
    5.  $\neg x_{E,M} \lor x_{L,B}$ (Emily not Mammal OR Laura focuses on Birds).
